typographie_suggestion.explanation: The primary headings (such as "MINERAIS MÉTALLIQUES") feature heavy, block-like serifs with little to no bracketing, characteristic of the Slab Serif style popular in 19th-century technical and commercial printing. The smaller body text utilizes a more traditional Old Style or Transitional serif.
